android.desc:
Experience your offline music library with unmatched acoustic clarity. QCurve is a high-fidelity offline music player and precision audio equalizer built around an advanced native C++ DSP engine. Designed for audiophiles and audio engineers, it is the ultimate MP3 and FLAC player for those who demand absolute control over their sound.

Whether you are driving custom speaker setups, high-impedance headphones, or mobile DACs, QCurve delivers pristine audio shaping without coloring your source tracks—unless you want it to.

🎛️ Precision 10-Band Equalizer
Switch effortlessly between Graphic and Parametric EQ modes. Fine-tune your frequency response with adjustable Q-factors, custom filter curves, and transparent digital summing.

🎧 Expert Dynamic Multiband EQ
Take surgical control of your tracks. Apply compression or expansion independently across specific frequency bands with customizable thresholds, ratios, attack/release times, and soft-knee transitions.

🔊 Acoustic Sound Enhancers & Bass Booster
Quickly shape your tone without manual EQ tweaking:

Bass Shelf & Sub-Bass: Deep, thunderous low-end control tailored for custom subwoofers and portable audio builds.

Mid Boost & Brilliance: Add acoustic warmth and high-end air across optimized frequency curves.

Loudness Maximizer: Integrated brickwall limiting and upward normalization ensure your tracks stay clean, loud, and free of digital clipping.

🎵 Advanced Audio Processing

Headphone Crossfeed: Blends L/R channels to simulate physical stereo speakers, drastically reducing listening fatigue during extended headphone sessions.

Vocal Remover: Center-channel extraction scoops out lead vocals and instruments for a live karaoke or instrumental feel.

Tube Saturation: Warm up your digital MP3s with adjustable analog-style harmonic drive and automated gain compensation.

Algorithmic Reverb & Echo: Add natural room acoustics, adjustable dampening, and tape-style delays equipped with built-in high-pass "mud killers."

🔒 100% Offline & Zero Telemetry
QCurve is a completely private, offline audio player. It scans your local storage (.flac, .mp3, .wav, .aac, .ogg) without ever tracking your listening habits, requiring an internet connection, or uploading your personal data.
